editorial_corrections.detail: Linear plot coordinate corrected from f(pH) to f([H+]); explicit editorial note in Korean.
Acid A corrected from orthophosphoric acid to phosphorous acid H3PO3, with explicit note and patent source link.
NaOH balance subtraction order corrected to 10*1.0 - 1.6*0.4 = 0.36 mmol; explicit note.
Mean repeat-unit mass corrected from 98.64 to 98.66, consistent with preceding calculation; explicit note.
Self-complementary 12-nt example changed to CCCCCCGGGGGG (C6G6); explicit note.
Glyoxal in source corrected to glyoxylic acid according to native HOOC-CHO structure; explicit note.
E identified as MnO2 rather than source sodium manganate, consistent with question and native E+HCl equation; explicit note.

Original density limits are internally inconsistent. Official 280.315-291.4 g/mol and delta 0.75-0 are quoted and explicitly identified as not reproducible from given density/reference values. No artificial unique interval supplied.
Mass balance 194.5-2n written as 194.5-2.02n retaining the stated H molar mass 1.01; resulting Ir identification unchanged.
Equilibrium mole fractions corrected to E+ 84%, D+ 16% from K=5.265; explicit note.
Macrocyclic cycloaddition product letter corrected from source S to P according to official problem scheme; explicit note.
